description: Restyle the four authenticated feature screens to DRIVE: dashboard, explore (search + results), profile, and reservation-detail (templates + their .scss). Depends on FEAT-001 (global helpers). Component .ts logic must NOT change; bind only to fields that exist in api.models.ts. Independent of FEAT-002/FEAT-003.
steps: DASHBOARD (src/app/features/dashboard/dashboard.component.html + .scss): DRIVE Dashboard look — .section-kicker date label (static), black greeting 'Good morning, {{ firstName }}.' (keep the {{ firstName }} interpolation; TS getter unchanged), a .btn.btn-primary 'Find a car' with routerLink="/explore". Render the Figma featured-booking dark card and 'Ready for pickup?' checklist as STATIC presentational markup (slate-950 .panel + amber .badge) — NO data bindings for them exist. Quick-action .panel cards link only to existing routes (/explore, /profile) with blue-50 .icon-tiles. PRESERVE: <app-feedback-message [message]="errorMessage()" />, every routerLink="/explore" and routerLink="/profile". Do not invent booking/data fields.

EXPLORE (src/app/features/explore/explore.component.html + .scss): restyle the search form into a DRIVE SearchBox bar (rounded-2xl white panel, soft shadow, blue field icons) keeping all five reactive controls with their exact option values. Render each available vehicle as a DRIVE CarCard (rounded-3xl bordered card, image/art area, blue-600 type kicker, name 'Available car N', STATIC spec row seats/transmission/fuel icons, STATIC price '/ day', reserve button). AvailabilityResponse only exposes locationId/startTime/endTime/availableVehicleIds (string[]) — spec/price text is STATIC decoration, never invented data. PRESERVE EXACTLY: [formGroup]="form", (ngSubmit)="search()", formControlName locationId (options loc-1/loc-2), start/end (datetime-local), vehicleCategory (economy/compact/sedan/suv/premium), currency (USD/EUR/INR); the search button [disabled]="busy()" dynamic label; <app-feedback-message [message]="errorMessage()" />; the full @if (busy()) / @else if (results(); as result) / @else if (searchFailed()) / @else if (hasSearched()) / @else chain; result.availableVehicleIds.length usage, the location ternary, the length===0 empty state, @for (vehicleId of result.availableVehicleIds; track vehicleId; let index = $index); (click)="reserve(vehicleId)", [disabled]="!!bookingVehicle()", the bookingVehicle() ternary label; and the retry (click)="search()" button.

PROFILE (src/app/features/profile/profile.component.html + .scss): DRIVE Profile — .section-kicker 'Your account', black 'Profile' heading, amber verification callout (static, in-page, no new route), personal-info .panel with a slate-950 avatar circle (static initials), name + member-since (static), global .field/.field-label grid for the real controls, .btn.btn-primary save. Restyle the addresses and KYC sections as .panels. PRESERVE EXACTLY: [formGroup]="profileForm"+(ngSubmit)="saveProfile()" (firstName/lastName/email/phone/preferredLanguage en|hi|fr); [formGroup]="addressForm"+(ngSubmit)="addAddress()" (label/line1/line2/city/state/postalCode/country/isPrimary checkbox); [formGroup]="kycForm"+(ngSubmit)="submitKyc()" (documentType jpeg|png/fileName/sizeBytes number min/max/licenseNumber/issuer); all @if (ctrl.invalid && .touched) <small> blocks; the three [disabled]="*Busy()" buttons with dynamic labels; all six feedback-message tags; the @if (addresses().length)/@else and @for (address of addresses(); track address.addressId) with address.label/line1/line2/city/country and @if (address.isPrimary); {{ kyc()?.status || 'Not submitted' }} and [class.status-pending]="kyc()?.status === 'pending'"; the .api-limitation note. Keep the email field editable (do NOT add readonly — that would change behaviour).

RESERVATION-DETAIL (src/app/features/reservations/reservation-detail.component.html + .scss): DRIVE Booking/Pickup look — status .badge (amber pending / emerald confirmed via the existing .confirmed class), car image/art + pick-up/return label grid using .label + DatePipe values, a payment-summary .panel (STATIC figures, no invented fields), a static timeline. PRESERVE EXACTLY: routerLink="/explore" (back link + unavailable CTA); @if (booking(); as reservation)/@else; {{ reservation.status }} and [class.confirmed]="reservation.status === 'CONFIRMED'"; both feedback-message tags (errorMessage, notice); {{ reservation.pickupDateTime | date:'medium' }} and {{ reservation.returnDateTime | date:'medium' }}; the three status @if blocks — (click)="confirm()" [disabled]="busy()" dynamic label, (click)="cancel()" [disabled]="busy()", and the status==='CANCELLED' copy.

After editing, confirm each of the four component .scss files stays under the 8kB production budget; move any shared primitive into the global styles.scss helpers from FEAT-001 rather than duplicating.
acceptance_criteria: Every listed binding/handler/signal/control-flow/routerLink/DatePipe usage across the four screens is preserved exactly; no new data fields are invented beyond api.models.ts.
The four screens visually match the DRIVE blue/slate/Manrope look (panels, badges, buttons, fields, kickers/titles) with no Wayfarer moss/coral palette remaining.
The four component .ts files are unchanged.
npm run build succeeds with no anyComponentStyle budget error, and npm test -- --watch=false passes.
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm success with no budget errors on the four component style files.
Run 'npm test -- --watch=false' and confirm all existing specs pass.
